# Repository-config corpus

Inputs for `corpus.test.ts` (Deno, real `cue` through `CUE_BIN`) and
`containers/runner/cue-job.test.ts` (the job script in the runner image).
Each case directory holds a repository's root `*.cue` files, of any CUE
package: Tartan config is the package `tartan` of the root files (see the repo-config ADR), and the CLI selects it
with `cue export .:tartan`. The forge files (the schema package `cue.mod/pkg/tartan.dev/ext/**` and the binding file
`~tartan.cue`) come from `generateSchema` over `CORPUS_SCHEMA` in
`testing/corpus.ts`, and each job writes its own `cue.mod/module.cue`:

- an own install `acme.no-secrets` (approved, with a `config.cue`);
- an own install `acme.labels` (approved, no `config.cue`: `settings: close({})`);
- an overlay `tartan.weave` (inherited, repo overrides on: `batch`, `debounceMs`);
- in force `tartan.ci` (repo policy key `pipeline`) and `tartan.review` (repo policy key `owners`).

| Case                         | Exercises                                                                                                                          | Expected (CUE v0.17.1)                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `valid`                      | overlay, own installs, repo policy, projects and global, comprehension, interpolation, a hidden field, five files, another package | exit 0; JSON in `corpus.test.ts`                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `package-selection`          | `_x.cue`, `*_tool.cue`, `*_test.cue`, an `@if` build tag and a package-less file beside package `tartan`                           | only package `tartan`'s files are loaded                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `other-only`                 | root files of another package only                                                                                                 | exit 0, `{}` (no Tartan config)                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `import-registry`            | an import of a registry module                                                                                                     | `INVALID_INPUT` naming the import and its position                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `import-repo-module`         | an import of the repository's own module                                                                                           | `INVALID_INPUT`                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `import-job-module`          | an import shaped like a job's module path                                                                                          | `INVALID_INPUT`, the path normalized to `<module>`                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `import-stdlib`              | an import of the standard library                                                                                                  | exit 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `embed-parent`               | `@embed` of a parent path                                                                                                          | `LOAD_INSTANCE`                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `embed-nonroot`              | `@embed` of a file that is never sent                                                                                              | `LOAD_INSTANCE`                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `invalid`                    | a type conflict, a bound, an unknown settings key, an unknown extension                                                            | exit 1, positioned issues                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `invalid-closed`             | closedness only: an unknown extension, an overlay's `enabled`, an overlay key not overridable                                      | exit 1, three `field not allowed`                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `pathological-comprehension` | 4,000 × 4,000 generated strings                                                                                                    | killed at the wall clock: `TIMEOUT`                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `pathological-doubling`      | 30 string doublings (1 GiB)                                                                                                        | `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` from RLIMIT_AS on native amd64; `TIMEOUT` where RLIMIT_AS does not apply (macOS, emulation)                                                                                                                  |
| `pathological-string`        | `strings.Repeat("x", 1 << 30)`                                                                                                     | CUE's builtin refuses it                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `pathological-nesting`       | 50,000 nested structs, generated by the tests                                                                                      | CUE's parser refuses it: `LOAD_INSTANCE`                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `pathological-export`        | 23 string doublings (8 MiB), exported                                                                                              | over the 4 MiB file cap: `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (cue ignores SIGXFSZ and exits 1; the job reports the cap)                                                                                                                          |
| `flood`                      | 5,000 errors (about 430 KB of text) inside the wall clock                                                                          | at most 64 KiB of error text reaches the host: `BUILD_VALUE` (or `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`), never `TIMEOUT`; CUE collects errors in time that grows with their square, so 50,000 errors outlast it and only the wall clock stops them |

The expected values are what the official CLI prints; the tests compare the
evaluator against a direct `cue export .:tartan` run of the same files as
well, and the container test compares the runner image's job with the host
evaluator case by case.
